test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Akshara sold an article for Rs. 25,000. If she had offered a discount of 15% on the selling price, then she would have earned a profit of 10%. What is the cost price?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price = Rs. 25000

Discount % = 15%

Profit % = 10%

**Concept:**

Cost Price = Selling Price / (1 + Profit%)

**Calculation:**

Selling price when 15% discount offered = Rs. 25,000 × 85% = Rs. 21,250

⇒ Cost price when profit of 10% = Rs. 21,250 / 110% = Rs. 19,318.18

**∴ The cost price of the article is approximately Rs. 19,318.18.**
